title: Cache is crucial
gist: Gateway data on what agent traffic is made of. Almost all of it is context being re-read from cache, billed at a fraction of the input price, and generated output is about one percent of tokens. Cache hit rate therefore matters more to the bill than list price.
changes: The single fact that ties the levers together. A cache belongs to one model on one machine, so it constrains which model answers, which machine takes the request and what gets evicted. Every router here is designed around it.
caveats: One gateway, skewed to developers and price-sensitive traffic. It does not measure the cost of switching models directly.

bears_on.note: The shape of agent traffic, nine-tenths re-read context, is what every serving decision now turns on.
Switching model mid-session re-reads everything at full price, which caps how often a router can act.
